title: A tree with something to say
subject: Arboreal Serenade
context: A tree changes throughout the day in ways we rarely notice. Live sensor readings shape an evolving audiovisual composition, creating an artistic portrait of processes normally hidden from our senses.

sources.label: UGT: Talking Tree at Art Basel (2025)

related.note: Both use technology to show processes our senses miss: a tree's slow rhythms, and a splash too fast to see.

editorialNotes: Roles are as listed on the project's own Team page (2026-11-25). Partners include UGT (measurement system).
An artistic translation of a Japanese Pagoda Tree's live signals (e.g. light and sap movement), not a recording of a tree speaking.
First shown at Art Basel 2025; now in the permanent collection of the Enea Tree Museum (Catapult; art.salon).
The 'Arboreal Severance' installation (2025) is a separate, later work by the same artists.
